in_marathi.name: Sangamesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Confluence
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sangamesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sangamesh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Sangam’ which means confluence or union. This name is often used to describe a place where two rivers meet or merge. In Hinduism, Sangamesh is also the name of a God who presides over such confluences.
